Package com.eventsphere.app.service

Class CommentService

java.lang.Object
com.eventsphere.app.service.CommentService
public class CommentService extends Object
Comments and replies on an event page. Reply rules (business rules, not database constraints): - a reply must point at a top-level comment on the same event, - a reply cannot itself be replied to, - a comment can have at most ONE reply. CommentDAO.insert(int, int, java.lang.String, java.lang.Integer) stays a dumb row writer; the rules live here so every caller (currently EventPageController) gets them.

    • authorNamesFor

      public Map<Integer,String> authorNamesFor(List<Comment> commentsToRender)
      Display names for the authors of the given comments, keyed by UserID, for the UI to render. Ids with no matching user row are left out, and the UI falls back to "User #<id>". Deactivated users are still resolved so old comments keep their author.

    • postComment

      public int postComment(int userId, int eventId, String content, Integer replyToCommentId)
      Posts a top-level comment (replyToCommentId == null) or a reply to one top-level comment. Rejects blank content and anything that breaks the reply rules with an IllegalArgumentException. Returns the generated CommentID.
